title: EMT Cardiac Electrical System
description: A ten-question knowledge check on the heart's electrical conduction system and basic ECG terminology.

questions.question: Which structure normally serves as the heart's primary pacemaker?
In which chamber is the sinoatrial (SA) node located?
What is the primary purpose of the electrical delay at the AV node?

answers.a: To allow the ventricles time to fill before they contract
answers.c: To increase the heart's oxygen demand

questions.question: What is the typical intrinsic rate of the AV junction when it becomes the pacemaker?
What is the typical intrinsic rate of the ventricular conduction system, including the Purkinje fibers?
What electrical event does the P wave represent on an ECG?
What electrical event does the QRS complex represent on an ECG?
What electrical event does the T wave usually represent on an ECG?
The PR interval is measured from the beginning of which waveform to the beginning of which complex?

answers.a: Beginning of the P wave to beginning of the QRS complex
answers.b: Beginning of the QRS complex to end of the T wave
answers.c: End of the P wave to end of the QRS complex
answers.d: Beginning of the T wave to beginning of the next P wave

questions.question: After leaving the AV node, which structure normally conducts the impulse into the interventricular septum before it divides into bundle branches?
